full_judgment: 17. It is on record that P.W. 2 is plaintiff's brother's jamai and P.W. 5 is the nephew of latter. The mere fact that some of the witnesses are related with the plaintiff is no ground for disbelieving them if they are otherwise found reliable. It is to be noted that the plaintiff is also related with defendant No. I being his chacha shasur as admitted by defendant No. 1 himself in his deposition. All these facts taken together create circumstances leading to a presumption of annulment which remains unrebutted.
